docs.text:
Apply exact, unique, non-overlapping edits to one doc version atomically. When: for small revisions after doc_read; match old_text against the original. Objects: doc. Skills: /methodology. Returns a compact receipt, or a conflict/match error (re-read).

Argument Type Required Meaning expected_version integer yes version you read edits list of object yes old_text/new_text pairs title string id string yes doc id

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, qa

docs.title: doc_query
docs.text:
List docs by doc_type/scope/owner_role. When: to find docs without an id. Objects: doc. Skills: /methodology. Enums: doc_type, owner_role, status (describe('enums')). Returns doc summaries as a ≤8 KB page + next_cursor; verbose=full rows.

Argument Type Required Meaning limit integer cursor string verbose boolean doc_type one of design, strategy_hl, strategy_ll, domain, report, note scope string owner_role one of owner, architect, sme, engineer, adversary, qa, doctor tag string status one of active, proposed, retired

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, sme

docs.title: doc_read
docs.text:
Read a doc (latest or a version), whole or a bounded range. When: a ticket or link points at a doc. Objects: doc. Skills: /methodology. Returns the doc; offset/limit/section: a version-pinned range.

Argument Type Required Meaning id string yes doc id version integer omit for latest; reuse the returned one to continue offset integer char offset; opts into bounded output limit integer chars, default 8192 when bounded section string exact heading line; offset is relative to it

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: doc_update
docs.text:
Replace a doc's body/title as a new version. When: to amend a doc you own. Objects: doc. Skills: /methodology. Returns a receipt; compact=false: the doc.

Argument Type Required Meaning id string yes doc id body_md string title string tags list of string replaces the tag list compact boolean

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, qa, sme

docs.title: link_create
docs.text:
Link from_id to_id (ticket/doc/artifact). When: to attach a design, strategy, evidence, blocker, artifact or doc layer. Objects: link. Enums: relation (describe('enums')). Returns the link. Argument Type Required Meaning from_id string yes subject (blocks: finishes first; extends: the more specific layer) to_id string yes object relation one of designed_by, uses_strategy, uses_domain, evidence_for, blocks, produced, extends yes from_id <relation> to_id

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, qa, sme

docs.title: link_delete
docs.text:
Remove a link. When: to undo a link made in error. Objects: link. Returns whether it was deleted.

Argument Type Required Meaning id string yes link id

Roles: architect

docs.title: link_query
docs.text:
List links by from_id/to_id/relation. When: to see what something is linked to. Objects: link. Enums: relation (describe('enums')). Returns the links as a ≤8 KB page + next_cursor; verbose=full rows.

Argument Type Required Meaning limit integer cursor string verbose boolean from_id string to_id string relation one of designed_by, uses_strategy, uses_domain, evidence_for, blocks, produced, extends

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, sme

docs.title: doctor_dead_mail
docs.text:
Broker publishes that had no recipient (publish_no_route). When: a message that never arrived. Objects: message. Returns the dead messages + causes.

Roles: doctor

docs.title: doctor_feed_lag
docs.text:
Per live seat: unread addressed messages, their age, last request and output. When: a seat that does not answer or wake. Objects: session. Returns seats + causes.

Roles: doctor

docs.title: doctor_health
docs.text:
Service health, the supervisor, package versions and pool reachability. When: first, for any 'it is broken' report. Objects: service. Returns services + causes (named root causes with a fix and a guide).

Roles: doctor

docs.title: doctor_logs
docs.text:
A redacted log tail (secrets, user paths, emails and tokens scrubbed). When: after a health or pool cause names a service. Objects: service. Returns the tail, or the available logs.

Argument Type Required Meaning service string yes board|broker|pool|mcp|bridge|supervisor|update|update-run, or pool-logs/<name>; a wrong name lists the available logs lines integer

Roles: doctor

docs.title: doctor_pains
docs.text:
Open pain records (tools or guides found wrong). When: to see whether a symptom is already known. Objects: pain. Skills: /pain. Returns the open pains.

Roles: doctor

docs.title: doctor_pool
docs.text:
Pool liveness, sessions, caps and usage, saturated caps and queued spawns. When: seats not spawning, false deaths, slow spawns. Objects: session. Returns the pool view + causes.

Roles: doctor

docs.title: propose_fix
docs.text:
Propose ONE fix as an admin approval card showing the exact action; nothing runs until an admin approves, then the result is posted on your thread. When: after the evidence names a root cause a listed action fixes. Objects: fix. Returns the proposal and its card.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string topic_id string yes your help thread (the topic in your context) action object yes {kind: service.restart|service.start|service.stop|pool.set_limits|gate.open|gate.answer|teammate.rotate_token|agent_token.revoke, ...its fields} effect string yes what the fix will do, in one or two plain sentences

Roles: doctor

docs.title: why_stuck
docs.text:
Why a ticket does not move: gates nobody can answer, a missing checker or doer seat, blockers, the next edges' missing preconditions, a full cap. When: a stuck ticket, epic or gate. Objects: ticket, gate. Skills: /ticket, /epic. Returns the ticket's facts + causes.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string yes the ticket the person says is stuck

Roles: doctor

docs.title: workflow_check
docs.text:
Validate a workflow version and walk its status graph (unreachable, dead ends). When: a stuck walk under a custom workflow, or a failed update compat check. Objects: workflow. Skills: /epic. Returns problems, walk + causes.

Argument Type Required Meaning ref string yes workflow id or id@version, e.g. standard@1

Roles: doctor

docs.title: harvest_cost
docs.text:
A seat's harvest token cost from its transcript, plus records it wrote. When: at epic acceptance, after the harvest. Objects: cost. Skills: /harvest. Returns window, token totals, record counts.

Argument Type Required Meaning participant_id string yes the seat since string until string

Roles: owner, qa

docs.title: pain
docs.text:
Pain log: query (q, area, status=all), read (id), file (severity, area, symptom, expected, evidence; dup_of), resolve (id, status). When: a tool or guide is wrong versus reality; query first. Objects: pain. Skills: /pain. Enums: action, severity (describe('enums')). Returns rows or the record.

Argument Type Required Meaning action one of query, file, read, resolve yes what to do id string q string area string status string severity one of low, medium, high symptom string expected string evidence string workaround string dup_of string supersedes string note string cursor string

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: service_status
docs.text:
Read-only host services: state, pid, port, git rev, uptime. When: a service seems down; restarting is a human action. Objects: service. Returns one row per service.

Roles: architect, doctor, owner

docs.title: teammate
docs.text:
Owner: teammate credentials: list, create (handle: invite link), mint (handle: token shown once), revoke. When: adding, re-keying or removing a person. Objects: teammate. Enums: action (describe('enums')). Returns the teammate, invite or token.

Argument Type Required Meaning action one of list, create, mint, revoke yes what to do handle string role string admin boolean

Roles: owner

docs.title: workflow
docs.text:
Owner: workflow versions: list, read (ref, full), duplicate (ref), edit|validate (definition), publish (ref). When: changing the workflow an epic pins. Objects: workflow. Skills: /epic. Enums: action (describe('enums')). Returns the version or its problems.

Argument Type Required Meaning action one of list, read, duplicate, edit, validate, publish yes what to do ref string new_id string definition object full boolean cursor string

Roles: owner

docs.title: context
docs.text:
Load your ticket(s): chain, criteria, docs, thread, open asks; byte-capped unless verbose. When: at boot, after compaction without a cursor, or when a delta says resync_required. Objects: ticket, message. Skills: /ticket. Returns ContextSnapshot with a cursor for context_delta; omitted names each fetch.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string one ticket, or omit for all yours verbose boolean full unbounded snapshot

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: context_delta
docs.text:
Read what changed for you since a context cursor. When: on a heartbeat wake, with your last cursor; not with context() routinely. Objects: event. Returns changes, next_cursor, has_more (byte-capped, omitted names the fetch); resync_required means context().

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string one ticket, or omit for all yours cursor string yes the cursor from your last context/delta limit integer max changes per page; continue if has_more

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: describe
docs.text:
An object type's fields and contract, or an enum's values ('enums' = all, 'enum:' = one). When: unsure of a type's fields or an argument's allowed values. Objects: enum. Returns the schema and contract, or the enum values. Argument Type Required Meaning type string yes an object type, 'enums', or 'enum:<Name>'

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: describe_objects
docs.text:
List object/enum names, or one object's schema. When: unsure of an object's contract; omit type to list names. Objects: enum. Returns the index or the schema.

Argument Type Required Meaning type string omit to list; an object name, a Context* type, 'enums' or 'enum:<Name>'

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: get_guide
docs.text:
Fetch one reference guide by name. When: a card or task names a guide. Objects: guide. Returns the guide's markdown, or not_found.

Argument Type Required Meaning name string yes guide name without .md

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: preflight
docs.text:
Host free RAM and live seats vs pool caps; advisory, never blocks. When: before a spawn. Objects: service, session. Returns the numbers and rules of thumb.

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: resume_self
docs.text:
Resume after a park, reap, crash or respawn: re-arm wakes, list open asks and steps. When: first call of a resumed shell, after compaction, or when unsure Monitor/cron are alive. Objects: session. Returns identity, ordered steps, monitor_cmd + cron, open asks; see get_guide('resume').

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: subscribe
docs.text:
Arm your event feed (once per session). When: at boot, right after whoami. Objects: event. Returns the monitor command and heartbeat cron to arm.

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: whoami
docs.text:
Your identity, role, open tickets, lineage and tool bundles. When: at boot. Objects: participant. Returns the participant, tickets, bundles and server version.

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: dense_search
docs.text:
Diagnostic: dense-only cosine top-k over an epic's live records. When: diagnosing why lookup missed a record. Objects: decision. Skills: /doubt. Returns hits with cosine scores.

Argument Type Required Meaning scope string yes epic or ticket id question string yes plain words k integer

docs.title: lookup
docs.text:
Current decisions, claims and lessons for a question, id or path in one epic (binding ones always). When: on resume or before acting, instead of trusting memory. Objects: decision, claim, lesson. Skills: /doubt, /learn. Returns records, rendered body and receipt.

Argument Type Required Meaning scope string yes epic or ticket id (never crosses epics) question string plain words; or use id/path id string record/ticket/doc id to start from path string file path to start from

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: record_claim
docs.text:
Record something stated but not yet shown, with basis and evidence. When: you assert something without attached proof. Objects: claim. Enums: basis (describe('enums')). Returns the claim.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string scope string yes epic or ticket id text string yes one sentence basis one of assumption, measured, ruled evidence list of string attachment/check/commit ids; a fact needs these plus measured|ruled source string message or doc id

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: record_decision
docs.text:
Record what is in force, why, and which decisions it replaces. When: the moment a ruling or in-authority decision is made, before acting on it. Objects: decision. Skills: /doubt. Returns the decision.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string scope string yes epic or ticket id it is in force for text string yes one sentence, <=240 chars detail string why, <=1000 chars replaces list of string older decision ids it supersedes binding boolean true = always handed to seats in scope; omit to inherit source string message, doc or attachment id domains list of string domain checklist names

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: record_lesson
docs.text:
Record a lesson: domain, topic, one sentence, evidence ids. When: /learn or /harvest. Objects: lesson. Skills: /learn. Returns the lesson.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string domain string yes domain name topic string yes short topic text string yes one sentence evidence list of string

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, qa, sme

docs.title: set_binding
docs.text:
Promote or demote a live decision's binding flag (architect/owner); audited. When: re-judging which decisions every seat must follow. Objects: decision. Skills: /doubt. Returns the decision.

Argument Type Required Meaning decision_id string yes a live decision binding boolean yes true = binding reason string one line, <=240 chars

Roles: architect

docs.title: topic_propose
docs.text:
File a proposed Library doc from a page topic_research fetched; the owner approves it. When: after research, or to propose the next version of a topic doc. Objects: topic, doc. Skills: /methodology. Enums: doc_type (describe('enums')). Returns the proposed doc with Source + fetched-at in its header.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string topic_id string yes Library topic id title string yes doc title body_md string yes what you distilled; the board prepends Source + fetched-at source_url string yes a URL topic_research fetched doc_type one of design, strategy_hl, strategy_ll, domain, report, note tags list of string proposes string active doc id this is the next version of

Roles: sme

docs.title: topic_research
docs.text:
Search skills.sh or read one page for your Library topic (skills.sh, GitHub, the seed host only). When: a topic seat's research step, before proposing a doc. Objects: topic. Returns search results, or ≤8 KB of page text plus the fetch receipt.

Argument Type Required Meaning topic_id string yes Library topic id query string search skills.sh url string offset integer

Roles: sme

docs.title: withdraw_claim
docs.text:
Withdraw a claim with no successor; lookup never returns it again. When: a claim was superseded or wrong and nothing replaces it. Objects: claim. Returns the withdrawn claim.

Argument Type Required Meaning claim_id string yes claim id reason string one line, <=240 chars

docs.title: withdraw_decision
docs.text:
Withdraw a decision with no successor; lookup never returns it again. When: a decision was wrong and nothing replaces it. Objects: decision. Skills: /doubt. Returns the withdrawn decision.

Argument Type Required Meaning decision_id string yes decision id reason string one line, <=240 chars

Roles: engineer

docs.title: close_self
docs.text:
End your own shell now; refused while inbox is non-empty or no status is recorded. When: step 3 of closing. Objects: session. Returns the release result; then stop calling tools.

Roles: adversary, doctor, engineer, qa, sme

docs.title: inbox
docs.text:
Questions and steers awaiting you, oldest first, each with answer_with. When: first when woken, and step 1 of closing. Objects: message. Returns the list (empty = clear).

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, qa, sme

docs.title: reap
docs.text:
Tear down a seat's shell (dead, or the resident architect at epic close). When: to clear a dead seat or close the architect after the epic. Objects: session. Returns confirmation, or running/unavailable.

Argument Type Required Meaning participant_id string yes seat id

Roles: architect, owner

docs.title: record_status
docs.text:
Record your outcome with a one-line note to your spawner, architect and owner. When: at milestones and as step 2 of closing. Objects: message. Enums: status (describe('enums')). Returns the message and who was told.

Argument Type Required Meaning status one of done, deferred, failed, blocked, reviewed, handed_off yes your outcome note string one line: done / left to string an extra recipient ticket_id string omit on a per-ticket seat

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, qa, sme

docs.title: resume
docs.text:
Resume a parked or stalled session. When: to wake a stalled seat. Objects: session. Returns the session, or running/unavailable.

Argument Type Required Meaning participant_id string yes seat id

Roles: architect, owner

docs.title: session_query
docs.text:
List sessions by participant/ticket/state. When: to check a seat is live. Objects: session. Enums: state (describe('enums')). Returns matching sessions, newest first, a ≤8 KB page + next_cursor; verbose=full rows.

Argument Type Required Meaning limit integer cursor string verbose boolean participant_id string ticket_id string state one of alive, stalled, dead, parked

Roles: architect, owner

docs.title: spawn
docs.text:
Start a seat for a role on a ticket. When: to delegate a story/task or spawn a checker. Objects: session, participant. Enums: role, effort, mode (describe('enums')). Returns the session, or status running (poll session_query).

Argument Type Required Meaning role one of architect, sme, engineer, adversary, qa, doctor yes seat role ticket_id string registers and assigns '<role>.<ticket_id>' participant_id string explicit pool handle; omit with ticket_id parent_session string spawning session id assign boolean default: only if unassigned/dead; false = checker; true = take over model string seat or model id; default: epic tag effort one of low, medium, high default: epic tag; Claude caps at medium mode one of headless, monitor

Roles: architect, owner

docs.title: assemble_ruleset
docs.text:
Compose a ticket's layered ruleset from its strategy/domain docs: enforced lines inlined, each doc one index line. When: at the start of a story/task, for your working brief. Objects: doc. Skills: /methodology. Returns enforced lines + a doc index (full adds constructive), or a cycle/missing-layer error.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string use its linked strategy/domain docs (inherited up the chain) doc_ids list of string explicit leaf doc ids instead full boolean also inline constructive lines

Roles: adversary, engineer, qa, sme

docs.title: find
docs.text:
Search tickets, criteria, docs and messages by words or meaning; hits carry ticket_id and epic_id. When: to find something without its id. Objects: ticket, doc, message. Skills: /ticket, /methodology. Returns ranked hits with snippets.

Argument Type Required Meaning query string yes words or a phrase (FTS + semantic) k integer types string comma list of ticket,doc,message,criterion epic_id string

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa

docs.title: gate_answer
docs.text:
Answer an open human gate (owner only). When: to resolve a gate a seat opened. Objects: gate. Skills: /epic. Enums: gate (describe('enums')). Returns the gate_answered event.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string yes ticket id gate one of design_signoff, poc, demo, adversarial, budget, acceptance, scope yes gate kind answer string yes the decision

Roles: owner

docs.title: gate_open
docs.text:
Open a human gate on a ticket (one per gate at a time). When: work needs a human decision. Objects: gate. Skills: /epic. Enums: gate (describe('enums')). Returns the gate_opened event; the owner is notified.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string yes ticket id gate one of design_signoff, poc, demo, adversarial, budget, acceptance, scope yes gate kind note string the answerer's question, plain words; blank note refused unless the workflow gate declares one

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer

docs.title: gates
docs.text:
List a ticket's open gates. When: to see if a ticket waits on a human. Objects: gate. Skills: /epic. Returns the open gates.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string yes ticket id

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, owner, qa

docs.title: message_query
docs.text:
List thread messages oldest first with seq; since_seq returns only newer ones. When: to read or poll a thread. Objects: message. Enums: kind (describe('enums')). Returns the newest page (since_seq pages forward): items with text clipped to 240 chars, last_seq, next_cursor (a hint names older pages).

Argument Type Required Meaning limit integer cursor string verbose boolean ticket_id string to string addressee id/role kind one of question, answer, steer, status, finding, deviation, note created_by string since_seq integer newer than this seq; 0 = from the start

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: message_read
docs.text:
Read one message with its seq, parent and replies. When: a feed event or reply_to names it. Objects: message. Returns the message.

Argument Type Required Meaning id string yes message id

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: message_send
docs.text:
Post to a ticket thread: a participant/role/@handle, or a note. When: milestones, blockers, questions, answers, hand-offs. Objects: message. Enums: kind (describe('enums')). Returns the message; asks reach the recipient's feed.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string ticket_id string yes thread ticket kind one of question, answer, steer, status, finding, deviation, note yes message kind text string yes message body to string id/@handle/role; omit=note reply_to string id answered artifacts list of string staged artifact ids code_context object quotes list of object

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: criterion_create
docs.text:
Add a checkable done-fact. Checker derived: qa (story/epic), engineer (task), owner (knowledge ticket); checked_by needs owner override_reason. Max 6 fresh per story. When: before work starts, one per checkable fact. Objects: criterion. Skills: /verify. Enums: check, checked_by (describe('enums')). Returns the criterion with its derived checker.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string ticket_id string yes ticket id text string yes the checkable fact check one of command, path, look, verdict yes how it is checked checked_by one of qa, owner, engineer override_reason string owner only: why the derived checker is overridden

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer

docs.title: criterion_query
docs.text:
List a ticket's criteria. When: to see what is pending. Objects: criterion. Skills: /verify. Returns the criteria.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string yes ticket id

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: criterion_update
docs.text:
Set a criterion's evidence_ref, then its verdict (checker only). When: as the checker after the evidence doc exists; a doer attaches evidence_ref only. Objects: criterion, doc. Skills: /verify, /methodology. Enums: verdict (describe('enums')). Returns the criterion and the pending count.

Argument Type Required Meaning id string yes criterion id evidence_ref string verdict one of pending, pass, fail set after evidence_ref (checker only) text string reword (author, while pending) evidence_version integer doc version signed; refused if below current stale_ok boolean sign the version you read though the doc moved on note string

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: ticket_create
docs.text:
Create an epic (owner), story (architect; owner: a quick task, tag quick, no parent) or task. At most 8 open stories per epic (raised via a scope gate), at most 5 tasks per story. When: you own a new slice of work. Objects: ticket. Skills: /ticket. Enums: kind, work_type (describe('enums')). Returns the ticket, or a scope error at a cap.

Argument Type Required Meaning idempotency_key string kind one of epic, story, task yes ticket level work_type one of feature, bug, rnd, creative, review, knowledge, chore yes kind of work title string yes epic: the owner's words verbatim (a short title is derived); story/task: the slice name words string epic or quick task: the owner's verbatim request; immutable parent_id string assignee string description string scope, intent, pointers to files/docs tags list of string

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, owner

docs.title: ticket_query
docs.text:
List tickets matching the filter args. When: to find tickets without an id. Objects: ticket. Skills: /ticket. Enums: kind, work_type, status (describe('enums')). Returns matching tickets as a ≤8 KB page + next_cursor; verbose=full rows.

Argument Type Required Meaning limit integer cursor string verbose boolean kind one of epic, story, task work_type one of feature, bug, rnd, creative, review, knowledge, chore parent_id string status one of drafted, designed, signed_off, ready, in_progress, in_review, blocked, done, partial, dropped assignee string epic_id string every ticket under this epic created_by string tag string q string exact words in title/description/tags

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, sme

docs.title: ticket_read
docs.text:
One read of a ticket: record, chain, criteria, docs, children, blockers, gates, newest thread (thread_seq), links. When: you need a ticket's full state. Objects: ticket, criterion. Skills: /ticket, /verify. Returns the ticket record.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string yes ticket id include string comma list of chain,criteria,docs,children,blockers,gates,thread,links; omit for all; lifecycle (only when named) = the pinned workflow's lifecycle table thread_limit integer newest thread messages to include (0-200)

Roles: adversary, architect, doctor, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: ticket_update
docs.text:
Change the args given, per the transition rules. When: to move or assign a ticket; in_review only once verified. Objects: ticket. Skills: /ticket. Enums: status (describe('enums')). Returns the ticket, or an error naming what is missing.

Argument Type Required Meaning ticket_id string yes ticket id status one of drafted, designed, signed_off, ready, in_progress, in_review, blocked, done, partial, dropped next legal status assignee string design_ref string design/plan doc id description string replaces the description tags list of string replaces the tag list title string short title, <=80 chars (architect/owner)

Roles: adversary, architect, engineer, owner, qa, sme

docs.title: Workflow definition schema
docs.text: Generated at build from the workflow engine's definition model (schema version 1). A workflow is data: the Design tab edits it, validates it and publishes versions; an epic pins the version it runs. Machine-readable: workflow.schema.json.

docs.title: WorkflowDef
docs.text: Field Type Required Default schema_version integer 1 id string yes version integer 1 name string "" description string "" builtin boolean false published boolean false source string or null null roles list of RoleDef yes kinds list of string yes statuses list of string yes terminal list of string transitions list of TransitionDef yes checkers list of CheckerRule yes caps map of integer gates list of GateDef permissions map of list of string hooks map of HookSetting

docs.title: CheckerRule
docs.text: Field Type Required Default when When or null null role string yes

docs.title: GateDef
docs.text: Field Type Required Default id string yes answerers list of string requires list of Precondition answer_requires list of Precondition question string ""

docs.title: HookSetting
docs.text: Field Type Required Default on boolean true params object

docs.title: Precondition
docs.text:
One named check. message/hint are templates filled from the predicate's detail ({id} {kind} {status} {to} {role} plus predicate fields). hook ties it to a hook's on/off.

Field Type Required Default check string yes params object when When or null null code one of scope, transition "transition" message string "" hint string "" hook string or null null phase one of open, answer, both "both"

docs.title: RoleDef
docs.text: Field Type Required Default id string yes label string "" human boolean false card string "" card_md string "" model string or null null harness string or null null effort string or null null bundle list of string or null null spawnable boolean false may_spawn list of string may_create list of string criterion_author boolean false criterion_checker boolean false gate_answerer boolean false doc_types list of string capacity_class one of builder, planner, checker or null null max_concurrent integer or null null kernel boolean true

docs.text: Field Type Required Default from string yes to string yes requires list of Precondition auto boolean false auto_when When or null null

docs.title: When
docs.text:
Which tickets a precondition (or checker rule) applies to; every set field must match.

Field Type Required Default kinds list of string or null null not_kinds list of string or null null work_types list of string or null null quick boolean or null null parentless boolean or null null from_in list of string or null null from_not_in list of string or null null quick_root boolean or null null

docs.title: Models catalog
docs.text: Generated at build from the models catalog's field table. The catalog (models.json in your data folder, edited in Admin → Models) lists every model a seat may run on and, per role, the models that role may use. Credentials never go in the catalog; they are secret settings.

docs.title: Top-level keys
docs.text: Key Meaning models every model a seat may run on: model id → a row (below) role_models role → the ordered list of model ids that role may run on; the first is its default default_model the model any role absent from role_models spawns on (custom workflow roles too)

docs.title: A model row
docs.text:
models.<model id> is one row; the id is what the harness is started with.

Field Meaning harness the program that runs the seat: claude, codex or pi provider who serves the model (for pi, the provider name Pi is configured with) model the model name passed to the harness, when it differs from the row's id context_window the model's context window, in tokens auto_compact the context size, in tokens, at which the seat compacts its conversation effort_cap the highest reasoning effort a seat on this model may be given: low, medium or high

docs.title: Allowed values
docs.text:
• harness: claude, codex, pi
  • effort_cap: high, low, medium (a claude row may not cap at high)
  • codex rows may leave context_window and auto_compact unset: the harness reports its own.
  • auto_compact must be below context_window; both are positive integers (tokens).

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text: All notable changes to Heronry are recorded here. The format follows Keep a Changelog, and versions follow Semantic Versioning. Every release is on the releases page.
First public release. Verified hands-on on Windows; macOS and Linux are built and tested in CI and community-tested, so please report issues.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• Heronry: the board, its seats and services, installable on Windows, macOS and Linux.
  • Heronry Desktop: a native window and tray icon, shipped as MSI, DMG and deb installers (unsigned).
  • The heronry command line: init, start, stop, status, doctor, update, import, gui.
  • A setup wizard, harness choice (Claude Code, Codex, Pi) and in-app updates.
  • One-line installers (install.ps1, install.sh) that verify every wheel against SHA256SUMS.
  • The Design tab: workflows, models and role cards as versioned data.
  • An admin console: settings, services, teammates and invites, remote access, integrations.

docs.title: Changed
docs.text:
• One version, 0.9.0, for the four Python packages (edp8, edp-contracts, edp-pool, edp-broker), the web app and the VS Code extension.
  • The codex consult bridge is gone; codex runs as ordinary seats.
  • Licensed under Apache-2.0 everywhere, the VS Code extension included.

docs.title: Security
docs.text:
• CI blocks a pull request on a new secret or on personal data (gitleaks with project rules, plus a byte-level PII gate over the tree and the release artefacts).
  • Every release asset is listed in SHA256SUMS and carries a build-provenance attestation.
  • Private material was removed from the tree at this release. Older commits still hold it; no live credential was found in them.
